name: unityai
description: Standalone local AI development orchestrator for Unity projects

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @unityai/core && npm run build --workspace @unityai/unity && npm run build --workspace @unityai/shared && npm run build --workspace @unityai/server && npm run build --workspace @unityai/unity-mcp && npm run build --workspace @unityai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @unityai/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @unityai/unity && npm run typecheck --workspace @unityai/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @unityai/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @unityai/unity-mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace @unityai/web && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @unityai/core && npm run build --workspace @unityai/unity && npm run build --workspace @unityai/unity-mcp && tsx --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/unity/test/*.test.ts apps/server/test/*.test.ts apps/unity-mcp/test/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.tsx
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @unityai/core && npm run build --workspace @unityai/unity && npm run build --workspace @unityai/shared && npm run dev --workspace @unityai/server
